dashboard_grid.rules: Every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children to stretch. Widgets should have solid 1px borders and no soft drop shadows. Border color should be subtle (border-white/10).

marketing_landing.rules: Asymmetrical layout. Leave breathing room. Use massive typography contrasting with small, precise technical details.

surface_strategy.cards: Flat Solid backgrounds (no glassmorphism for data panels). 1px crisp borders. Sharp corners or max 4px radius (rounded-sm).
surface_strategy.terminal: Deepest black container (bg-[#050505]), inset shadow, glowing borders when active.

xterm_terminal.instructions: Use xterm.js package. Container must have p-4, bg-[#050505], overflow-hidden, and a blinking cursor. Font must map to JetBrains Mono.

severity_badges.styles: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase rounded-sm border

drag_drop_upload.styles: border-2 border-dashed border-white/20 bg-white/5 hover:border-primary/50 hover:bg-primary/5 transition-colors p-12 text-center rounded-sm

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'Tracing Beam' or glowing 1px lines for active/running scans.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle CRT scanlines over the terminal or hero background (repeating-linear-gradient).

animations.pulse: Use animate-pulse for running scan indicators and CRITICAL severity dots.
animations.typing: Simulate typing for AI POC generation output.

motion.transitions: Fast, precise, mechanical (0.15s ease-out). No slow floating animations. It should feel like a tactical terminal.
motion.loaders: Instead of spinners, use running binary codes, progress bars, or ASCII loaders.

media_and_icons.icon_library: lucide-react (apply sharp/technical usage) or phosphor-icons if installed.

hero_background.description: Matrix movie still - use with heavy black overlay (bg-black/80) to allow text to pop.

feature_infrastructure.description: Data center neon tunnel for architecture/cloud integration section.

3d_libraries_and_creative.recommendation: Use tsparticles for a digital mesh/node network background in the hero section to give an elite cybersecurity feel without bloating performance.
3d_libraries_and_creative.alternative: ASCII art background rendering via basic React canvas.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text on deep black backgrounds. Color is for accents and severity indicators only.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, terminal inputs, and upload zones MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Theme. No generic purple AI gradients. Use Matrix Green (#00FF41) or Crimson as highlights.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk. Use JetBrains Mono for all code, tables, numbers, and badges, and IBM Plex Sans for headings.
Ensure 'xterm.js' is properly installed and embedded for the web terminal tab.
Make the Dashboard dense like a SOC (Security Operations Center) panel. Use borders (border-collapse style) rather than floating cards.
Implement real-time scan progress visualization (pipeline stages).
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays, dialogs, or dropdowns. Use solid dark panel backgrounds (#111111) with 1px borders.
Add 'data-testid' to all critical interactive nodes (e.g., data-testid='upload-zip-btn', data-testid='terminal-container').
universal_guidelines: Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
Create depth through 1px sharp borders and inset shadows rather than large diffuse drop shadows.
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖🧠💭). Use technical icons.
Incorporate generous padding around text within bordered containers to prevent collision (p-6 or p-8).
Use standard modern button shapes (sharp corners or max 4px radius) with hover state contrast shifts.
Do not apply 'transition: all'. Explicitly animate transform, opacity, or background-color.
